source: NVIDIA public cuDNN dataGrad_cpu_ref<float>, explicit layout/traversal specialization
adaptation: Specialize public cuDNN dataGrad to one spatial axis, cross-correlation, alpha=1, beta=0, unit stride/dilation and no padding. Use TBC/KIO storage and invert the gather relation into a scatter traversal following gradient TBC order. These manual dimension/layout/traversal adaptations change floating-point reduction order; the runtime packs the same values for the cuDNN API.
